dialogues.jp: 卒業式で、泣くことはないと思ってた。
dialogues.en: Suginami stands with a smirk on his face.
dialogues.text: Suginami stands with a smirk on his face.

dialogues.jp:
予行練習では、何回やっても別になんとも感じ
なかった。
dialogues.en:
"Hey, don't feel embarrassed. All the tears you shed today
are precious and beautiful."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, don't feel embarrassed. All the tears you shed today
are precious and beautiful."

dialogues.jp: だから、まさか泣くことはないと思ってた。
dialogues.en: "You cried, didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "You cried, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の目尻には熱いものがたまっていた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami makes a great show of laughing loudly. Well, I
won't ask him any more.
dialogues.text:
Suginami makes a great show of laughing loudly. Well, I
won't ask him any more.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「は？　俺が泣くわけないだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Today is the last day of our life on this campus. Don't you
feel a little sentimental?"
dialogues.text:
"Today is the last day of our life on this campus. Don't you
feel a little sentimental?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並がニヤニヤと笑いながら立っている。
dialogues.en: "Life on the next campus won't be much different."
dialogues.text: "Life on the next campus won't be much different."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、別に恥ずかしいことじゃあない。
　今日流れた涙は、すべて尊く美しい涙だ」
dialogues.en: "Tell me about it."
dialogues.text: "Tell me about it."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はハッハッハと芝居がかった笑いで返事を
した。深くは言及するまい。
dialogues.en:
There are some students going to other schools outside the
island.
dialogues.text:
There are some students going to other schools outside the
island.

dialogues.jp:
中には、本校には進学せずに、島の外の学校に
行くヤツもいる。
dialogues.en:
It's not like we won't see each other for the rest of our
lives. However, it's still sad for anyone to say goodbye..
dialogues.text:
It's not like we won't see each other for the rest of our
lives. However, it's still sad for anyone to say goodbye..

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「音夢が居なくなっちゃったら、あんた、生活
　どうするつもり？」
dialogues.en: "How are you going to live without Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "How are you going to live without Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「飛躍的に向上するだろう」
dialogues.en: "I'll live more happily than ever before."
dialogues.text: "I'll live more happily than ever before."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。ま、４月になったらもう少し大人
　になってほしいものね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, sure. I hope you'll grow up on the new campus."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, sure. I hope you'll grow up on the new campus."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「目を真っ赤にしてる眞子に言われたかないね」
dialogues.en: "Did you cry too much? Your eyes look like a rabbit's."
dialogues.text: "Did you cry too much? Your eyes look like a rabbit's."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「う、うっさいわね、ほっときなさいよ、そん
　なの」
dialogues.en: "Shut up. It's none of your business."
dialogues.text: "Shut up. It's none of your business."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が慌てて、目尻をこする。
dialogues.en: Mako rubs her eyes.
dialogues.text: Mako rubs her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「代わり映えしないって言っても、あたし達が
　こうやって卒業したっていうのは随分大きな
　変化よね」
dialogues.en:
"I know there won't be much of a difference on the new
campus, but the fact that we graduated is a big difference,
don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"I know there won't be much of a difference on the new
campus, but the fact that we graduated is a big difference,
don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあな、変わらないのは、せいぜい景色くら
　いのものだ。変わるのは自分自身だ」
dialogues.en:
"That's right. The view we get won't change. The only change
we will see will be within ourselves."
dialogues.text:
"That's right. The view we get won't change. The only change
we will see will be within ourselves."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「アンタはわかってるみたいね」
dialogues.en: "YOU get it!"
dialogues.text: "YOU get it!"

dialogues.jp:
まるで俺だけがわかっていないみたいな、そん
な言い方だな。
dialogues.en: So she thinks I don't?
dialogues.text: So she thinks I don't?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、式も無事に終わったことだし、我々は後
　は必殺の計画を遂行しようではないか」
dialogues.en:
"Now that the ceremony is over, all we have to do is to
carry out our deadly plan."
dialogues.text:
"Now that the ceremony is over, all we have to do is to
carry out our deadly plan."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前だけな」
dialogues.en: "You do it. I won't."
dialogues.text: "You do it. I won't."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「むむっ」
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんただけね」
dialogues.en: "It looks like you're on your own..."
dialogues.text: "It looks like you're on your own..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はうっ……」

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 「水越せんぱーい」
dialogues.en: "Mizukoshi-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Mizukoshi-sempai!"

dialogues.jp: 遠くの方から、女の子の声がする。
dialogues.en: I hear a girl's voice from afar.
dialogues.text: I hear a girl's voice from afar.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、後輩の子が来たから、あたし行くね」
dialogues.en: "That's a friend of mine. I've got to go now."
dialogues.text: "That's a friend of mine. I've got to go now."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、もう行くのか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, come on. You're leaving already?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, come on. You're leaving already?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ、来月からも死ぬほど顔を合わせるん
　だからいいでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"We'll be seeing each other soon anyway whether we like it
or not. Am I right?"
dialogues.text:
"We'll be seeing each other soon anyway whether we like it
or not. Am I right?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ごもっとも」
dialogues.en: "You're right."
dialogues.text: "You're right."

dialogues.jp:
眞子はじゃあね、と言って、その後輩のいるほ
うに走っていった。
dialogues.en: Mako runs toward her friend.
dialogues.text: Mako runs toward her friend.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「卒業していく先輩と後輩とのドラマか……。
　ありがちだが、感動の物語だな」
dialogues.en:
"This sounds like an inspiring story of friendship on
graduation day..."
dialogues.text:
"This sounds like an inspiring story of friendship on
graduation day..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、わんこはどうしたんだ？　こう
　いう時には、真っ先に来てそうなものだが」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, what happened to that girl? She should be here
by now."
dialogues.text:
"By the way, what happened to that girl? She should be here
by now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「美春か。そういやそうだな」
dialogues.en: "Miharu? Yeah, you're right..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu? Yeah, you're right..."

dialogues.jp:
確かにあいつならこういうオイシイ状況を逃す
はずがない。
dialogues.en:
Miharu is the kind of person who wouldn't miss this kind of
thing.
dialogues.text:
Miharu is the kind of person who wouldn't miss this kind of
thing.

dialogues.jp: どうしたんだろうな……？　気になる。
dialogues.en: I wonder what happened... I'm getting worried.
dialogues.text: I wonder what happened... I'm getting worried.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、教室へ戻るか。大切なものは、
　きちんと収めておかないとな」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't we go back to our classroom? We'd better put the
important stuff in the safe place."
dialogues.text:
"Why don't we go back to our classroom? We'd better put the
important stuff in the safe place."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はそう言って、卒業証書の入った筒の｛ふた／蓋｝を、
キュポンと鳴らした。
dialogues.en:
Suginami makes a popping sound as he takes the lid off his
diploma case.
dialogues.text:
Suginami makes a popping sound as he takes the lid off his
diploma case.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、悪りぃ。ちょっと、用を思い出した。
　俺、別行動な」
dialogues.en: "Hey, sorry. I forgot something. I've got to go."
dialogues.text: "Hey, sorry. I forgot something. I've got to go."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「構わんぞ。お前の居場所ぐらい、いつでも捕
　捉可能だからな」
dialogues.en: "Go wherever. It's easy to find you."
dialogues.text: "Go wherever. It's easy to find you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さよか。じゃ」
dialogues.en: "Sure. See you later."
dialogues.text: "Sure. See you later."

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、今日は学園に来てないんじゃない
だろうか。
dialogues.en: Maybe Miharu isn't at school today.
dialogues.text: Maybe Miharu isn't at school today.

dialogues.jp: まさか、また調子が悪くなって……。
dialogues.en: She may be sick again...
dialogues.text: She may be sick again...

dialogues.jp: 胸がきゅうっと締めつけられる気がした。
dialogues.en: It feels like something is squeezing my chest.
dialogues.text: It feels like something is squeezing my chest.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、暦先生に会いにいこう。
dialogues.en: I go to see Koyomi-sensei first.
dialogues.text: I go to see Koyomi-sensei first.

dialogues.jp: 「先生」
dialogues.en: "Sensei."
dialogues.text: "Sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉。どうしたんだい？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura. What's new?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura. What's new?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あの……先生」
dialogues.en: "Um... sensei..."
dialogues.text: "Um... sensei..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まさか、最後の最後で、あたしに告白？
　そりゃあ、時期柄ロマンチックだけどさ」
dialogues.en:
"Wait! You're not gonna confess that you actually had a
crush on me or something? That's pretty romantic, but..."
dialogues.text:
"Wait! You're not gonna confess that you actually had a
crush on me or something? That's pretty romantic, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Sensei..."
dialogues.text: "Sensei..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、今から体育館の裏に来いって？
　確かに、色々やった気はするけど、何もそこ
　まで……」
dialogues.en:
"Wait! Or you're going to beat me up or something? I know I
did some awful things to you, but that's..."
dialogues.text:
"Wait! Or you're going to beat me up or something? I know I
did some awful things to you, but that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いつまでジョークかましてるんですか。美春
　のことですよ」
dialogues.en: "No... Nothing like that. It's about Miharu."
dialogues.text: "No... Nothing like that. It's about Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、天枷か。ああ、そうそう。あの子、今
　日は来ていないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah. Amakase? Right, right. She didn't come to school
today."
dialogues.text:
"Ah. Amakase? Right, right. She didn't come to school
today."

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、悪夢のような想像が｛のうり／脳裡｝をよぎる。
dialogues.en: "She didn't come to school? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "She didn't come to school? What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、心配する程じゃあない。休んでいれば、
　元に戻る。ただ、大事をとって、あたしが休
　むように言ったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. She needs some rest. I told her to stay home
today."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. She needs some rest. I told her to stay home
today."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんですか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、せっかくなんだから朝倉は卒業パーティー
　を楽しみなよ」
dialogues.en: "You should go enjoy the graduation party."
dialogues.text: "You should go enjoy the graduation party."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。わかりました。ありがとうござ
　います」
dialogues.en: "You're right. Thank you."
dialogues.text: "You're right. Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、先生に会釈をして、準備室を出た。
dialogues.en: I bow to Koyomi-sensei and leave her room.
dialogues.text: I bow to Koyomi-sensei and leave her room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「よくよく考えれば、朝倉にはつらい思いをさ
　せてしまうんだねぇ」
dialogues.en: "He's going to go through some tough stuff -- eventually."
dialogues.text: "He's going to go through some tough stuff -- eventually."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、中庭で杉並の姿を見つけた。
dialogues.en: I find Suginami, and we start walking around again.
dialogues.text: I find Suginami, and we start walking around again.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「これから、演劇部に行かないか？」
dialogues.en: "Why don't we go to the drama club?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't we go to the drama club?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　演劇」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? The drama club?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? The drama club?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「実は情報提供や、演出を一部手伝っている」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, I've been helping them a bit with info-service
and stage direction."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, I've been helping them a bit with info-service
and stage direction."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「爆破か？　それとも電流か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you gonna blow the club up?"
dialogues.text: "Are you gonna blow the club up?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「無駄に爽やかな笑顔で、何を言っているんだ、
　おまえは？」
dialogues.en:
"What the hell are you talking about with that smile on your
face?"
dialogues.text:
"What the hell are you talking about with that smile on your
face?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうする、行くか？　まあ、爆破でもいいぞ。
　それも面白そうだ」
dialogues.en: "Wanna go? Or do you still want to blow it up?"
dialogues.text: "Wanna go? Or do you still want to blow it up?"

dialogues.jp:
コイツの基準は、いつも常人とはかけ離れた領
域にある。
dialogues.en: "I was just kidding..."
dialogues.text: "I was just kidding..."

dialogues.jp:
「おまえが言うと本気に聞こえるぞ。……とは
　言え、う〜ん、どうするか……」
dialogues.en: "Not really."
dialogues.text: "Not really."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　予定でもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you look nervous."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you look nervous."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Do I?"
dialogues.text: "Do I?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何かそわそわしてるな、おまえ」
dialogues.en: "I'm a man of great insight. You didn't know?"
dialogues.text: "I'm a man of great insight. You didn't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: I know now.
dialogues.text: I know now.

dialogues.jp:
実はさっきから、学園内を歩いていて、ずっと
落ち着かない。
dialogues.en: Yes, I feel very edgy while walking around the campus.
dialogues.text: Yes, I feel very edgy while walking around the campus.

dialogues.jp: 美春のことが、どうにも気がかりなのだ。
dialogues.en: I'm worried about Miharu.
dialogues.text: I'm worried about Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いな、杉並。お前の言う通りかも知れない」
dialogues.en: I can't stop wondering how she is doing...
dialogues.text: I can't stop wondering how she is doing...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ、その程度を見抜くことなど造作もない。
　で、気がかりは、わんこのことか？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, dude. You're right..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, dude. You're right..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "That girl?"
dialogues.text: "That girl?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だったら、うだうだしてないで、さっさと行
　くべきだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「男の苦悩している顔は、俺のような美男子に
　こそふさわしい。おまえには能天気なバカ笑
　いがお似合いだ」
dialogues.en: "Then you'd better go see her."
dialogues.text: "Then you'd better go see her."

dialogues.jp: 口は悪いが、杉並の目は穏やかに笑っていた。
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、ちょっくら行ってくらぁ」
dialogues.en: I don't want to be with anyone else now.
dialogues.text: I don't want to be with anyone else now.

dialogues.jp: 結局、今は誰ともいられない気がした。
dialogues.en: It's Miharu who occupies my mind now.
dialogues.text: It's Miharu who occupies my mind now.

dialogues.jp: 俺の頭の中にあるのは、美春のことばかり。
dialogues.en: I'm wondering how bad she is.
dialogues.text: I'm wondering how bad she is.

dialogues.jp:
調子が悪いって先生は言ってたけど、大丈夫な
のかな。
dialogues.en: It's too much of a burden on her...
dialogues.text: It's too much of a burden on her...

dialogues.jp: やはり、負担が大きくて……。
dialogues.en: How long will I be able to be with Miharu?
dialogues.text: How long will I be able to be with Miharu?

dialogues.jp: それが美春の命を刻一刻と縮めていってるのか。
dialogues.en: For a year? Half a year? Or only a month?
dialogues.text: For a year? Half a year? Or only a month?

dialogues.jp: 美春とはいつまで一緒にいられるんだろう。
dialogues.en: What if the real Miharu woke up?
dialogues.text: What if the real Miharu woke up?

dialogues.jp: １年後？　半年後？　それとも、１ヶ月後？
dialogues.en:
Her effort to find her memories damages Miharu's body a
great deal.
dialogues.text:
Her effort to find her memories damages Miharu's body a
great deal.

dialogues.jp:
本物の美春が意識を回復したら、ロボットの美
春はどうなるんだろう。
dialogues.en: It's surely shortening her life.
dialogues.text: It's surely shortening her life.

dialogues.jp:
記憶を思い出そうとすればするほど、美春の身
体には負担がかかる。
dialogues.en:
The more she remembers something, the more damage it does to
her.
dialogues.text:
The more she remembers something, the more damage it does to
her.

dialogues.jp: それは確実に彼女の寿命を縮めていく。
dialogues.en: Someday we will all part from our loved ones.
dialogues.text: Someday we will all part from our loved ones.

dialogues.jp:
思い出せば思い出したで、その記憶はやはり美
春の身体に負担を強いる。
dialogues.en:
Of course, however, it's better if that happens as late as
possible. It's better to stay with your loved ones for as
long as possible.
dialogues.text:
Of course, however, it's better if that happens as late as
possible. It's better to stay with your loved ones for as
long as possible.

dialogues.jp:
別れというものは、誰であれ遅かれ早かれ訪れ
るものだというけれど、
dialogues.en: I wish time could just stop.
dialogues.text: I wish time could just stop.

dialogues.jp:
遅い方がいいに決まっている。長い間、ずっと
一緒にいられたほうが絶対いいに決まっている。
dialogues.en: And then, she and I could be together forever.
dialogues.text: And then, she and I could be together forever.

dialogues.jp: 時間が止まってしまえば、どれほど幸せだろう。
dialogues.en:
I find myself in familiar surroundings. I look up at the sky
and feel a familiar breeze.
dialogues.text:
I find myself in familiar surroundings. I look up at the sky
and feel a familiar breeze.

dialogues.jp: そうすれば、ずっと一緒にいられるのに。
dialogues.en: Nonetheless, I can feel my environment has changed slightly.
dialogues.text: Nonetheless, I can feel my environment has changed slightly.

dialogues.jp: 別れもなく。悲しみもなく……。
dialogues.en:
The cherry tree grows. New life springs from the ground. No
two clouds in the sky look the same.
dialogues.text:
The cherry tree grows. New life springs from the ground. No
two clouds in the sky look the same.

dialogues.jp:
変わらない景色の中で、変わらない風を受けな
がら、空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: In reality, every day is a new day.
dialogues.text: In reality, every day is a new day.

dialogues.jp:
変わらないようでも、景色は絶えず変化してい
るのだ。
dialogues.en: Nothing remains the same.
dialogues.text: Nothing remains the same.

dialogues.jp:
桜の樹は成長し、地面には新しい草が生え、同
じ雲はひとつとしてない。
dialogues.en:
Today I've ended my student life on that campus. I used to
think things would be the same forever.
dialogues.text:
Today I've ended my student life on that campus. I used to
think things would be the same forever.

dialogues.jp: 流れゆく日々は、いつも新しい毎日なのだ。
dialogues.en: "Sempai..."
dialogues.text: "Sempai..."

dialogues.jp: 変わらないものは、ただのひとつとしてない。
dialogues.en: "Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu?"

dialogues.jp:
いつまでも変わらないと思っていた学園生活も、
今日ひとつのピリオドを打った。
dialogues.en: Miharu appears from the shade beneath the big cherry tree.
dialogues.text: Miharu appears from the shade beneath the big cherry tree.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "I knew you'd be here today."
dialogues.text: "I knew you'd be here today."

dialogues.jp:
一番大きな桜の木の陰から、美春がひょっこり
と現れる。
dialogues.en: "I thought you weren't feeling good today...?"
dialogues.text: "I thought you weren't feeling good today...?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩なら、ここへ来ると思ってました」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine now. I can walk."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine now. I can walk."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「調子が悪いんじゃなかったのか……？」
dialogues.en: Miharu steps forward slowly.
dialogues.text: Miharu steps forward slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、大丈夫です。歩いても平気です」
dialogues.en: "I think I'm getting some important memories back."
dialogues.text: "I think I'm getting some important memories back."

dialogues.jp: 美春がすっと前に出てくる。
dialogues.en: "Important memories?"
dialogues.text: "Important memories?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことより、美春は大切な記憶を思い出
　しそうなんです」
dialogues.en: "Something that happened here a long time ago."
dialogues.text: "Something that happened here a long time ago."

dialogues.jp: 美春の額には、珠のような汗が浮き出ていた。
dialogues.en: A single bead of sweat slides down from Miharu's forehead.
dialogues.text: A single bead of sweat slides down from Miharu's forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、夢で見たんです。美春と先輩がこの木
　の下にいた夢……」
dialogues.en: "I had a dream yesterday. You and I were under this tree."
dialogues.text: "I had a dream yesterday. You and I were under this tree."

dialogues.jp: 美春の身体がぐらりと傾く。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Miharu's body is leaning to one side.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Miharu's body is leaning to one side.

dialogues.jp:
「美春！　思い出しちゃダメだ。思い出したら、
　お前の身体は……」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu! Don't try to remember anything! If you do, you're
gonna..."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu! Don't try to remember anything! If you do, you're
gonna..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫です。美春にとって、思い出を甦らせ
　ることは一番大切なことだから……。それに、
　この思い出は……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm fine. Getting my memories back is the most important
thing for me. Besides, this particular memory is..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm fine. Getting my memories back is the most important
thing for me. Besides, this particular memory is..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が、俺の胸の中に身体を預ける。
dialogues.en: Miharu leans over my chest.
dialogues.text: Miharu leans over my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そう……、あれは美春が先輩のことを誘った
　んです。願い事を叶えたくて」
dialogues.en:
"I invited you into my dream because I wanted my wish to
come true."
dialogues.text:
"I invited you into my dream because I wanted my wish to
come true."

dialogues.jp: 願い事……。昨日の夢……。
dialogues.en: Your wish... The dream I had yesterday...
dialogues.text: Your wish... The dream I had yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「この木の下で……」
dialogues.en: "Under this tree..."
dialogues.text: "Under this tree..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春、少し我慢しててくれ」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, hold on just a second."
dialogues.text: "Miharu, hold on just a second."

dialogues.jp:
俺は美春をゆっくりと立たせ、木に寄りかから
せる。
dialogues.en: I lean her against the tree.
dialogues.text: I lean her against the tree.

dialogues.jp: 「確か、ここだったよな……」
dialogues.en: "It should be around here..."
dialogues.text: "It should be around here..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、適当な石を拾い、地面を掘り始める。
dialogues.en: I begin to dig with a stone.
dialogues.text: I begin to dig with a stone.

dialogues.jp: ――ガッ、ガッ
dialogues.en: Dig... dig...
dialogues.text: Dig... dig...

dialogues.jp: ――ガッ、ガッ
dialogues.en: Dig... dig...
dialogues.text: Dig... dig...

dialogues.jp:
砂利の混ざった土を掘り起こす。場所はうろ覚
えだけど、なぜか確信があった。
dialogues.en:
I keep digging out dirt that's full of gravel. It must be
here.
dialogues.text:
I keep digging out dirt that's full of gravel. It must be
here.

dialogues.jp: あの時、俺と美春は――。
dialogues.en: That day -- Miharu and I were...
dialogues.text: That day -- Miharu and I were...

dialogues.jp: ――カツン
dialogues.en: Thud.
dialogues.text: Thud.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あった……」
dialogues.en: "I found it!"
dialogues.text: "I found it!"

dialogues.jp:
ガツガツと手を動かし、手ごたえのあった周り
を掘り進めていく。
dialogues.en: I then start to dig it out with my hands.
dialogues.text: I then start to dig it out with my hands.

dialogues.jp: そして、出てきたものは――。
dialogues.en: It's in there.
dialogues.text: It's in there.

dialogues.jp: 「この缶……。たしか美春と一緒に埋めた……」
dialogues.en: "The canister -- Miharu and I buried it together."
dialogues.text: "The canister -- Miharu and I buried it together."

dialogues.jp: タイムカプセル。
dialogues.en: A time capsule.
dialogues.text: A time capsule.

dialogues.jp: 確か、そうだった。
dialogues.en: That's it!
dialogues.text: That's it!

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「大切なものと一緒に願い事を書いて入れてお
　くと願い事が叶うんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Your wish will come true if you put it away with something
you treasure."
dialogues.text:
"Your wish will come true if you put it away with something
you treasure."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「埋めた人と一緒に掘り出すんだよな」
dialogues.en:
"And you're supposed to dig it out with the person you
buried it with, right?"
dialogues.text:
"And you're supposed to dig it out with the person you
buried it with, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「掘り出す約束をしていた日が、｛・・／今日｝……」
dialogues.en: "Today is the day that we promised to dig it out."
dialogues.text: "Today is the day that we promised to dig it out."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「記憶を――思い出したんだな」
dialogues.en: "You remember that now."
dialogues.text: "You remember that now."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I do."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I do."

dialogues.jp: 缶は、もう錆びついていて絵も煤けていた。
dialogues.en: The canister is rusty and sooty.
dialogues.text: The canister is rusty and sooty.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、土を払ってやれば、色あせたお菓子の
絵が現れた。
dialogues.en:
But the picture on it is gradually reappearing as I wipe the
dirt off.
dialogues.text:
But the picture on it is gradually reappearing as I wipe the
dirt off.

dialogues.jp: 「なんともないのか？　その……身体」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? You must be..."
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? You must be..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今はなぜか、すごく気持ちがいいです。何か
　｛すがすが／清々｝しい感じ」
dialogues.en: "I feel so good and refreshed."
dialogues.text: "I feel so good and refreshed."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Good to hear..."
dialogues.text: "Good to hear..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「一緒に開けよう」
dialogues.en: "Let's open it."
dialogues.text: "Let's open it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Sure..."
dialogues.text: "Sure..."

dialogues.jp: ふたりで土を払い、蓋に手をかける。
dialogues.en: We wipe the dirt off and then begin to take the lid off.
dialogues.text: We wipe the dirt off and then begin to take the lid off.

dialogues.jp:
スムーズとはいかないけれど、缶の中身は長い
年月の沈黙を破り、日の目を見た。
dialogues.en: The lid is taken off for the first time in years.
dialogues.text: The lid is taken off for the first time in years.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「すごい……。綺麗なままですね」
dialogues.en: "Wow... It's still clean in there."
dialogues.text: "Wow... It's still clean in there."

dialogues.jp: 缶の中は、外観ほど汚れていなかった。
dialogues.en:
The inside of the canister doesn't look as dirty as the
outside.
dialogues.text:
The inside of the canister doesn't look as dirty as the
outside.

dialogues.jp:
中にはビニール袋に包まれたオルゴールの箱と、
壊れかけのプラモが入っていた。
dialogues.en:
Inside is a music box and a half broken plastic model in a
plastic bag.
dialogues.text:
Inside is a music box and a half broken plastic model in a
plastic bag.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「自分の書いた願い事、覚えていますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you remember what you wrote?"
dialogues.text: "Do you remember what you wrote?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや。覚えてないな」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't..."
dialogues.text: "No, I don't..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春は、覚えていますよ」
彼女はそう言って、ビニール袋を破く。
dialogues.en: She tears up the plastic bag.
dialogues.text: She tears up the plastic bag.

dialogues.jp: あの頃の空気の匂いが、ツンと鼻腔をくすぐる。
dialogues.en: I got a whiff of air inside the box.
dialogues.text: I got a whiff of air inside the box.

dialogues.jp: 「このオルゴールは……」
dialogues.en: "This music box..."
dialogues.text: "This music box..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩が美春の誕生日にくれたものです」
dialogues.en: "You gave it to me for my birthday."
dialogues.text: "You gave it to me for my birthday."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったっけ」
dialogues.en: "Gee, I don't remember..."
dialogues.text: "Gee, I don't remember..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、先輩、全然覚えてない〜」
dialogues.en: "You don't remember!?"
dialogues.text: "You don't remember!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「悪りぃ、なんせ子供の時のことだから」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I was just a kid."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I was just a kid."

dialogues.jp: そして、次はプラモを取り出す。
dialogues.en: Then I take the plastic model out of the bag.
dialogues.text: Then I take the plastic model out of the bag.

dialogues.jp: 懐かしいな。確か、昔好きだったヤツだ。
dialogues.en: I remember this one. I used to love it.
dialogues.text: I remember this one. I used to love it.

dialogues.jp: 背中に紙がくくりつけてある。
dialogues.en: There is a piece of paper attached to the back of the model.
dialogues.text: There is a piece of paper attached to the back of the model.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩の願いはなんだったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What was your wish?"
dialogues.text: "What was your wish?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだろな」
dialogues.en: "Let's see..."
dialogues.text: "Let's see..."

dialogues.jp:
なんて書いたか覚えてない時点で、大したこと
を書いてないのは間違いない。
dialogues.en: Since I don't remember at all, it shouldn't be anything big.
dialogues.text: Since I don't remember at all, it shouldn't be anything big.

dialogues.jp: 『世界が平和でありますように』
dialogues.en: A wish for world peace.
dialogues.text: A wish for world peace.

dialogues.jp: ……見なきゃよかったな。
dialogues.en: I shouldn't have looked...
dialogues.text: I shouldn't have looked...

dialogues.jp: ちらりと美春の顔を見る。
dialogues.en: I glanced at Miharu.
dialogues.text: I glanced at Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 美春はクスクスと笑いながらその紙を取る。
dialogues.en: Miharu takes the paper with a chuckle.
dialogues.text: Miharu takes the paper with a chuckle.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩らしいですよ。すごく」
dialogues.en: "I think it's quite like you, sempai."
dialogues.text: "I think it's quite like you, sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、今でもそういうのを書きそう」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's very like you to write a thing like that."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's very like you to write a thing like that."

dialogues.jp:
なんか否定できないな。でも、今の俺が願いを
書くとしたら――。
dialogues.en: How can I deny it then? But what would I wish for now?
dialogues.text: How can I deny it then? But what would I wish for now?

dialogues.jp: 「美春はなんて書いたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What did you write, Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "What did you write, Miharu?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は美春のオルゴールを手に取り、蓋に手をか
ける。
dialogues.en: I take the music box and try to open the lid.
dialogues.text: I take the music box and try to open the lid.

dialogues.jp: 「あれっ、開かない？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? It won't open."
dialogues.text: "Hmm? It won't open."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「これは、こうして開けるんです」
dialogues.en: "This is how you open it."
dialogues.text: "This is how you open it."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、美春は首からねじ巻きを外して、
オルゴールの鍵穴にはめた。
dialogues.en:
Miharu takes her wind-up screw off from round her neck and
put it into the hole on the box.
dialogues.text:
Miharu takes her wind-up screw off from round her neck and
put it into the hole on the box.

dialogues.jp: そして、キチキチと回す。
dialogues.en: And she winds it up.
dialogues.text: And she winds it up.

dialogues.jp: 「そうやって使うものだったのか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that's how you do it..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that's how you do it..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、開きますよ」
dialogues.en: "Ready? It'll open."
dialogues.text: "Ready? It'll open."

dialogues.jp:
ねじ巻きを抜くと、オルゴールは静かに音色を
奏で始めた。
dialogues.en:
As soon as the screw is pulled out, the box begins to play
soft music.
dialogues.text:
As soon as the screw is pulled out, the box begins to play
soft music.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「この鍵は美春が持ってるの」
dialogues.en: "I've kept the key with me."
dialogues.text: "I've kept the key with me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「約束の日に、美春が開けたいの。他の人が開
　けたら、願い事は叶わないんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted to open it on our promised day. If someone else
opens it, your wish won't come true. I had to be sure I did
it myself."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted to open it on our promised day. If someone else
opens it, your wish won't come true. I had to be sure I did
it myself."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春の願い事って？」
dialogues.en: "What was your wish, Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "What was your wish, Miharu?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「言っちゃダメなんだもん」
dialogues.en: "I'm not supposed to tell you."
dialogues.text: "I'm not supposed to tell you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、絶対に絶対に願い事を叶えたいんだ
　もん。だからお兄ちゃんでも教えない」
dialogues.en:
"I really want this wish to come true, so I'm not gonna tell
anybody, even you, oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"I really want this wish to come true, so I'm not gonna tell
anybody, even you, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そんなに言うんなら、仕方ないよなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I give up if you insist..."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I give up if you insist..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん、このタイムカプセル、必ず一緒
　に開けようね。約束の日に絶対開けようね。
　約束だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Let's open this time capsule together on the day of our
promise. Can you promise?"
dialogues.text:
"Let's open this time capsule together on the day of our
promise. Can you promise?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わかったよ、もう。美春はしつこいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I know. I know..."
dialogues.text: "I know. I know..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、美春の大切な願い事が入ってるんだ
　もん。このねじ巻きもずっと美春が持ってる
　んだもん」
dialogues.en: "I have a very important wish inside. I'll keep this key."
dialogues.text: "I have a very important wish inside. I'll keep this key."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――じゃ、閉めるね」
dialogues.en: "Let me close it."
dialogues.text: "Let me close it."

dialogues.jp: ――パチン
dialogues.en: Whump.
dialogues.text: Whump.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――開いた」
dialogues.en: "It's open."
dialogues.text: "It's open."

dialogues.jp:
オルゴールの蓋は、柔らかな音楽とともにゆっ
くりと開かれた。
dialogues.en: The lid for the music box opens along with gentle music.
dialogues.text: The lid for the music box opens along with gentle music.

dialogues.jp: オルゴールの中は小物入れになっていた。
dialogues.en: The inside of the music box is like a little case.
dialogues.text: The inside of the music box is like a little case.

dialogues.jp: そして、小さく折り畳まれた紙が１枚。
dialogues.en: And there's a piece of folded paper inside.
dialogues.text: And there's a piece of folded paper inside.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「これが、美春の願いです……。子供の頃から
　叶えたかった美春の夢です」
dialogues.en:
"This is my wish... The wish I've always wanted to come
true."
dialogues.text:
"This is my wish... The wish I've always wanted to come
true."

dialogues.jp:
紙を広げると、そこにはクレヨンで書かれた、
あまり綺麗とは言えない字で、
dialogues.en: On the paper is the words written with a crayon.
dialogues.text: On the paper is the words written with a crayon.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「『お兄ちゃんとずっと一緒でいられますよう
　に』」
dialogues.en: "I wish to be with oniichan forever."
dialogues.text: "I wish to be with oniichan forever."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春の願いは叶いました」
dialogues.en: "My wish has come true."
dialogues.text: "My wish has come true."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「願いが叶ったって……」
dialogues.en: "It has...?"
dialogues.text: "It has...?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩とずっと一緒にいられることです」
dialogues.en: "Being with you forever, sempai."
dialogues.text: "Being with you forever, sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ずっとじゃない……。俺と美春はいつか別れ
　なければならないんだ。それに、記憶を思い
　出したってことは、それより早く――」
dialogues.en:
"It can't be forever... You and I have to be parted some day
soon. Besides, if you get your memories back, that might
happen even earlier..."
dialogues.text:
"It can't be forever... You and I have to be parted some day
soon. Besides, if you get your memories back, that might
happen even earlier..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「一緒ですよ。たとえ、美春がいなくなったと
　しても、先輩と美春はずっと一緒です」
dialogues.en:
"It's the same. Even if I'm gone, you and I will be always
together."
dialogues.text:
"It's the same. Even if I'm gone, you and I will be always
together."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「一緒にいられるのは、後少しじゃないか……。
　現にさっきはあれほどつらそうにしてたじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en:
"But we're only gonna to be together for a while, aren't we?
You couldn't even hold yourself up a second ago."
dialogues.text:
"But we're only gonna to be together for a while, aren't we?
You couldn't even hold yourself up a second ago."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春が先輩のことを覚えている限り、先輩が
　美春のことを覚えている限り、ずっと一緒で
　す。そうじゃないですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It's the same -- as long as I remember you and you remember
me. Don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"It's the same -- as long as I remember you and you remember
me. Don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「『美春さん』の記憶を思い出して、美春は、
　わかりました。美春がどれだけ先輩のことを
　好きなのか」
dialogues.en:
"Now that I have got some of Miharu-san's memories, I'm more
convinced now how much I love you, Sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Now that I have got some of Miharu-san's memories, I'm more
convinced now how much I love you, Sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと一緒にいたい。この気持ちを美春が忘
　れない限り、先輩と一緒にいられます。それ
　が、わかったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I know that as long as I keep these feelings, I can be with
you."
dialogues.text:
"I know that as long as I keep these feelings, I can be with
you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、夢が叶ったっていうのか」
dialogues.en: "That's why you think your wish came true..."
dialogues.text: "That's why you think your wish came true..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩は、美春がいなくなったら、美春のこと
　を忘れちゃいますか？」
dialogues.en: "Will you forget about me if I'm gone?"
dialogues.text: "Will you forget about me if I'm gone?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「忘れないよ。どんなことがあったって忘れな
　い。きっと、ずっと、忘れない」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm not. Never. I'll never forget about you."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm not. Never. I'll never forget about you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "You know...?"
dialogues.text: "You know...?"

dialogues.jp: 美春がくすくすと笑った。
dialogues.en: Miharu chuckles.
dialogues.text: Miharu chuckles.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春が先輩のことを好きになって、先輩が美
　春のことを好きになってくれて。想いは一緒、
　いつまでも一緒ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I love you, and you love me. Our feelings for each other
will stay together forever."
dialogues.text:
"I love you, and you love me. Our feelings for each other
will stay together forever."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「俺は美春が好きだ。だから、ずっと忘れない。
　ずっと一緒だよ」
dialogues.en:
"I love you, Miharu. I'll never forget about you. You and I
will be together forever."
dialogues.text:
"I love you, Miharu. I'll never forget about you. You and I
will be together forever."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春もです」
dialogues.en: "Ditto."
dialogues.text: "Ditto."

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春のことをきゅうっと抱きしめた。
dialogues.en: I hold Miharu tight.
dialogues.text: I hold Miharu tight.

dialogues.jp:
覚えていたい。言葉だけじゃなく、身体で、こ
の五感で美春のことを覚えていたい。
dialogues.en:
I want to remember the feel of her body and soul, and not
just her words.
dialogues.text:
I want to remember the feel of her body and soul, and not
just her words.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――思い出探しはこれっきりにします」
dialogues.en: "I'm not going to look for my memories any more."
dialogues.text: "I'm not going to look for my memories any more."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「俺もそうしてほしい。いくら美春の願いだと
　しても、これ以上苦しんでいる姿は見ていら
　れないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Good. I can't stand to see you in pain any more, even if
that's what you want."
dialogues.text:
"Good. I can't stand to see you in pain any more, even if
that's what you want."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃないんです。『美春さん』の記憶を
　思い出して、わかったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I realized something when I was trying to get Miharu-san's
memories."
dialogues.text:
"I realized something when I was trying to get Miharu-san's
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「思い出は誰かに作ってもらうものじゃないん
　です。思い出は自分で作るものなんです」
dialogues.en:
"A memory is not something someone else makes for you. It's
something you make yourself."
dialogues.text:
"A memory is not something someone else makes for you. It's
something you make yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どれだけ、記憶を思い出しても、美春は美春
　なんです。何も変わらないんです」
dialogues.en:
"No matter how many memories I bring back, something always
stays the same -- that's me. I can't change myself. "
dialogues.text:
"No matter how many memories I bring back, something always
stays the same -- that's me. I can't change myself. "

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「周りの人のために『天枷美春さん』の記憶を
　思い出そうとしましたけど、それで周りの人
　達の目が変わるわけじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"I was trying to get back Miharu Amakase-san's memories for
other people, but I realized that's not going to change how
they see me."
dialogues.text:
"I was trying to get back Miharu Amakase-san's memories for
other people, but I realized that's not going to change how
they see me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「さっちんも洋子も美春の友達です。『美春さ
　ん』じゃなくても、それは変わらない」
dialogues.en:
"Sacchin and Yoko are my friends. Even though I'm not the
real Miharu-san, they're still my friends."
dialogues.text:
"Sacchin and Yoko are my friends. Even though I'm not the
real Miharu-san, they're still my friends."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、思い出なんかなくても、美春は『美
　春さん』でいられるんです」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I can live my life as 'Miharu-san' without any
memories."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I can live my life as 'Miharu-san' without any
memories."

dialogues.jp:
美春に『美春』の記憶がなくても、『美春』で
あろうとするだけで、充分だったに違いない。
dialogues.en:
To her, it's enough to just be Miharu even without her
memories.
dialogues.text:
To her, it's enough to just be Miharu even without her
memories.

dialogues.jp:
目の前の美春をどう見るかは、相手次第という
ことだ。
dialogues.en: It's up to the eyes of others how they see Miharu.
dialogues.text: It's up to the eyes of others how they see Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
変わっていっているのに、ずっと変わらないよ
うに見える景色のように。
dialogues.en:
Just like the views we get here -- they look the same
although they are constantly changing.
dialogues.text:
Just like the views we get here -- they look the same
although they are constantly changing.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、それなら、思い出探しをしただけ……
　無駄だったってことか」
dialogues.en: "But did we waste our time looking for your memories?"
dialogues.text: "But did we waste our time looking for your memories?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は力なく呟いた。
dialogues.en: "In fact, you even risked your life doing it."
dialogues.text: "In fact, you even risked your life doing it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Sempai."
dialogues.text: "Sempai."

dialogues.jp: 腕の中にいる美春の声が、俺の身体に直接響く。
dialogues.en: Miharu's voice vibrates through my chest.
dialogues.text: Miharu's voice vibrates through my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「無駄じゃありませんよ。思い出探しは、結果
　的に美春の思い出を作ることができました」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing was wasted, because searching for memories allowed
me to make my own."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing was wasted, because searching for memories allowed
me to make my own."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「思い出を探して、先輩と過ごした日々のこと、
　美春は絶対忘れません」
dialogues.en:
"I'll never forget the days we spent together looking for my
memories."
dialogues.text:
"I'll never forget the days we spent together looking for my
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春には、たくさんの思い出が出来ました。
　先輩を好きになることだって出来ました」
dialogues.en:
"I was able to make a lot of good memories, and find true
love."
dialogues.text:
"I was able to make a lot of good memories, and find true
love."

dialogues.jp:
美春を好きになったのだって、思い出探しをし
ようとする、優しい心に惹かれたわけだし、
dialogues.en: "I'll never forget our time together either..."
dialogues.text: "I'll never forget our time together either..."

dialogues.jp:
いつでも笑顔でいた美春を、ずっと見ていたか
らだ。
dialogues.en: I was attracted to her because of her sincerity and smile.
dialogues.text: I was attracted to her because of her sincerity and smile.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「『美春さん』の思い出探しじゃなく、美春の
　思い出探しだったんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"In the end, I wasn't looking for Miharu-san's memories, but
I was looking for my own."
dialogues.text:
"In the end, I wasn't looking for Miharu-san's memories, but
I was looking for my own."

dialogues.jp:
温かい美春の身体。こうして抱き合っている１
分１秒でさえ、俺にとっての大切な思い出に変
わっていっている。
dialogues.en:
I feel the warmth of Miharu's body. Each second we hold each
other becomes a treasured memory.
dialogues.text:
I feel the warmth of Miharu's body. Each second we hold each
other becomes a treasured memory.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩――美春はもっと先輩との思い出が欲し
　いと思ってます」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, I want more memories with you."
dialogues.text: "Sempai, I want more memories with you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「俺だって、美春との思い出が――」
dialogues.en: "Me too. I want more memories with you, Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Me too. I want more memories with you, Miharu..."

dialogues.jp: はたと気がつき、顔を起こす。
dialogues.en: I raise my face.
dialogues.text: I raise my face.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「キス――してもらえますか？」
dialogues.en: "Will you kiss me?"
dialogues.text: "Will you kiss me?"

dialogues.jp: 美春が、潤んだ目で俺の方を見ていた。
dialogues.en: Miharu looks at me with teary eyes.
dialogues.text: Miharu looks at me with teary eyes.

dialogues.jp: ◆タイムカプセル◆
dialogues.en: ◆I didn't think I would cry during graduation.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I didn't think I would cry during graduation.◆

dialogues.jp:
卒業式。本来なら、いの一番に駆けつけてくる
美春が姿を見せなかった。暦先生に聞くと、今
日は大事をとって学校を休んでいるらしい。
dialogues.en: Because I didn't feel anything during the rehearsal.
dialogues.text: Because I didn't feel anything during the rehearsal.

dialogues.jp:
その後、校内をぶらぶらしてみたが落ち着かな
かった。どうも美春のことが気になってしまう。
そんな俺の背中を杉並が押してくれた。
dialogues.en: So crying is totally unexpected.
dialogues.text: So crying is totally unexpected.

dialogues.jp:
枯れない桜の下。そこに美春はいた。その額に、
珠のような汗を浮かべながら、大切な記憶を思
い出しそうと美春は言った。
dialogues.en: The moment I thought this was the last day on this campus.
dialogues.text: The moment I thought this was the last day on this campus.

dialogues.jp:
そして美春は思い出した。俺と一緒に埋めたタ
イムカプセルのことを。
dialogues.en: Also the moment I realized this was really the last day.
dialogues.text: Also the moment I realized this was really the last day.

dialogues.jp:
大切なものと一緒に願い事を書いて入れておく
と願い事が叶うという、タイムカプセルのこと
を。
dialogues.en: Those moments brought tears to my eyes.
dialogues.text: Those moments brought tears to my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりでタイムカプセルを開ける。そこに書か
れていた美春の願い。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I didn't sob like the girls in my class, but just
a single tear slid down my cheek.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I didn't sob like the girls in my class, but just
a single tear slid down my cheek.

dialogues.speaker: 美春
dialogues.jp:
「『お兄ちゃんとずっと一緒でいられますよう
　に』」
dialogues.en: "Did you cry?"
dialogues.text: "Did you cry?"

dialogues.jp:
その願いは叶ったと笑う美春を、俺は抱きしめ
た。
dialogues.en: "What? Me? Of course not!"
dialogues.text: "What? Me? Of course not!"
